title: PNP to Atong Ang: This is the best time to turn yourself in
summary: The Philippine National Police on Wednesday called on businessman Charlie "Atong" Ang, who is the alleged mastermind in the disappearances of several sabungeros, to turn himself in to the authorities.

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday called on businessman Charlie "Atong" Ang, who is the alleged mastermind in the disappearances of several sabungeros, to turn himself in to the authorities.
The PNP made the statement after a new warrant of arrest was issued by a Manila court against Ang, according to GMA News reporter Jun Veneracion.

"And if he really believes na he's innocent, this is the best time to turn yourself over, in, rather, para maharap niya ang mga kaso at mapatunayan niya kung wala talaga siyang kasalanan," said PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Allen Rae Co in a press briefing.
(And if he really believes that he's innocent, this is the best time to turn yourself over—in, rather—so that he can face the charges and prove whether he really has no guilt.)

‘THIS IS THE BEST TIME TO TURN YOURSELF IN’ PANOORIN: Nanawagan ang Philippine National Police (PNP) sa negosyanteng si Charlie “Atong” Ang na sumuko kasunod ng panibagong warrant of arrest na inilabas ng korte laban sa kaniya kaugnay ng kaso ng mga nawawalang sabungero. Sinabi ng PNP na nakatuon sila sa paghahanap kay Ang at may nakalaang P20 million na pabuya sa sinumang makapagbibigay ng impormasyon patungkol sa kinaroroonan ng negosyante. Hindi naman muna nagkomento ang PNP sa mga ulat na posibleng nasa labas na ng Pilipinas si Ang. | via Jun Veneracion/GMA News Bisitahin ang https://t.co/bAMF9JO2Xs para sa updates.— GMA News (@gmanews) November 25, 2026

The Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 175 has issued an arrest warrant against Ang and dismissed Police Lieutenant Ryan Jay Orapa in relation to their alleged involvement in the missing sabungeros case, the Department of Justice confirmed on Tuesday.

Moreover, the PNP is being cautious in handling emerging reports that Ang is already outside the Philippines. The PNP said it will focus on searching for the fugitive businessman, who has a P20-million bounty.
"This is an active manhunt operation. So we cannot disclose any other further details unless mayroon na tayong development, then we will update you in the appropriate time," said Co.

(This is an active manhunt operation. So we cannot disclose any other further details unless we already have a development, then we will update you at the appropriate time.) —Vince Angelo Ferreras/KG, GMA News
